remarks: Contemporary end-unit townhouse in the heart of exciting downtown Stamford features newer designer kitchen w/granite & stainless, living room w/fireplace, den/office w/built-ins & amazing top floor primary suite with walk-in closet & full bath. There is also a 2nd generous bedroom, 2nd floor laundry, attached garage, private storage area and balcony! Very pretty rooms have designer features and hardwood flooring. Enjoy being steps to downtown Stamford's fun attractions ~ the Avon Theater, popular restaurants, bars, boutiques, train station, shopping mall and the Ferguson library. Pets accepted per owner discretion & may require additional pet security deposit. Come see.
